summary: The sheet contains window types, a door hardware schedule, and a door schedule. Door and window dimensions, hardware notes, accessibility-related notes, and fire-rated gasket requirements are visibly documented. One title-block drafting defect was identified: the first-issue revision date is shown as “00.”

drafts.title: First-issue revision date is incomplete or placeholder text
drafts.observation: The revision block lists revision “00” as “FIRST ISSUE” with the date shown as “00,” rather than a discernible date or an explicit N/A designation.
drafts.drawing_evidence: Revision block at the right side of the title block: “00 FIRST ISSUE 00.”
drafts.recommendation: Confirm whether “00” is intentional. If not, replace it with the actual first-issue date or an approved notation indicating that no date applies, and coordinate the revision history with the permit-set issue date.
